instructions: Read only the supplied original passage. Classify what the passage CLAIMS, never its authenticity, actual issuance, legal force, permission or fulfillment. A request or unsigned draft is not an issued variation. Historical descriptions are not current obligations. Copy source evidence verbatim with infer:false; leave absent source fields null. Distinguish a current condition concerning an old object from a historical description of past arrangements. Do not reproduce the prerequisite lists handled by Extract. Scene associations are investigation leads, not verified applicability.

claimed_role.description: The documentary role expressly claimed by this passage. claims_issued_variation means the source claims issuance of a narrow variation; it is never independent proof of issue. request_only includes unsigned proposals or extensions awaiting approval. historical_reference describes past records only. current_condition states current documentary arrangements. unrelated_or_unclear when none is established.

claim_quote.description: The complete supplied original passage, copied verbatim as the statement a human must inspect. Include historical statements and negative or unissued statements unchanged. This field copies source text; it does not decide its role.

referenced_instrument.description: The exact name or identifier of ONE referenced supporting consent, letter, schedule, annex or authorization that a human should locate and inspect. Not physical equipment or personnel. Null when no supporting instrument is referenced.

scope_quote.description: Exact words specifying which planned activity or scene the documentary claim concerns; null when scope is not stated.
